dashboard.label: Data Health
dashboard.description: An emitted import is not yet active. Reconciliation compares distinct record IDs against expected logical groups before publishing a ready marker. Year grain uses snapshot history; Comparable YTD ends at the import calendar date. Empty charts mean no eligible data in the selection. Automatic selects the first available metric; invalid bookmarked IDs show an explicit unavailable state. Availability is snapshot-wide and refreshes every five minutes.
